assessments.domain: Whole publisher and exact regression continuity
assessments.assessment: The entire current publisher module and entire integration test file were read. All 68 previous publication/integration test and helper functions are AST-identical to the exact sealed 21061 review, including all assertions. Unchanged publication test bodies use that explicit full-content review bridge; all three added test bodies and their seven parameterized cases were read afresh. Only publisher prepare/publish changed, plus the new shared HEAD helper. The source interface delta is confined to its live Git-state check; whole source operator review remains assigned to the separate technical reviewer.

The shared helper compares actual Git HEAD to the genuine completed source baseline. The original initial callback remains, and explicit checks now close complete preparation, dry-run output preflight and each complete publisher recheck after the actual source proof and all reserved/native-output checks. The exact prior PUB001 counterexample now raises instead of returning complete, and clears both success receipts. A new actual late commit after the final native-receipt byte read also refuses.

A genuinely tracked derived file was included in the accepted private baseline and changed without committing after source application. Actual source application, Claw generation and publication pass. After a later unrelated commit, historical validation passes; changing current owner bytes then refuses. This is not a relaxed current owner/proof check, and the live HEAD restriction was not incorrectly applied to historical completed validation. A same-commit detached HEAD dry run passes, consistent with commit-based authority.

Three reviewer private fixtures use real source prepare/apply, the tracked native make_receipt.py, pinned Claw76c generation, native row replay and publisher gates with the actual J/eac 27-receipt history. The original negative wraps the real owner proof only to schedule a private Git commit after its unchanged result. The fresh negative uses sys.setprofile without replacing native function objects or results. Neither positive path substitutes proof, generation or validation.

assessments.domain: Accepted relocation and full row scope
assessments.assessment: The source completion tuple, authentic old owner hash, same basename/subject mapped-to-unmapped relocation, zero generated demoted ontology/registry slots and every old selected slot remain required. Thirty-one re-executed stage controls cover ontology plus all three registry slots, omissions, unexpected generated prefixes, malformed relocation tuples, unrelated rows, subject collision, and both prior owner chains. These stage probes are expressly not whole prepare/apply claims.

The prospective receipt is validated and replayed through unchanged native chain code; either relocation path with a prior owner chain refuses. Old policy pins/history, suppression sidecar/baseline and unrelated physical rows remain preserved. The inherited 27-receipt held-row lineage integration test is AST-identical. Mechanical fixtures and this code review confer no source, ontology, ingredient, role, export, merge or release acceptance.

Complete source inventories, checkpoint/protected membership, immutable identities and retired-path absence are retained. Stage probes refuse hidden additions, same-byte inode swaps, aliases, hardlinks and proof drift. A fresh actual native generation input symlink with identical target bytes refuses before any output. Both late HEAD failures preserve authentic canonical/policy recovery backups and leave empty native/publication success receipts; no rollback is claimed. Standalone validate intentionally reconstructs accepted state rather than verifying later arbitrary recovery-folder changes.

assessments.domain: Source index correction and remaining gap
assessments.assessment: The new source check examines cached paths with literal NUL framing, disables rename folding, checks stages/modes/blobs against installed accepted endpoints, and rechecks HEAD. This corrects the earlier already-present index-only examples. It does not retain one coherent index across enumeration and entry reads. Independent readback of all four root fixtures and actual native completed verification confirms the two late index mutations are still accepted despite unaccepted staged content. The unchanged HEAD and working bytes are directly verified; this retains W08-7D4DB26-SRC-001 under the existing #1256 native lineage.

Static accounting finds 144 publisher cases and 20 real-generator integration cases, including seven additions (five native). The reviewer did not duplicate the full combined suite or claim its result. The author manifest has 132 exact checked members, but its PASS is author evidence only. Publisher-specific checks support correction of PUB001; the confirmed source freshness residual prevents acceptance of the combined head for application.
